thread:
Maria L.: Heads-up: seeing odd kernel score flips at seqlen ~512 in prod profiling. KV cache hit rate looks stable but token latency spiked.
Aj Patel: saw that on nightly trace too. scoreboard sometimes picks int8_gemm_v2 which benchmarks slower at 512 with small batches.
Sanjay R: can you paste the trace snippet? might be autotuner mis-scoring because batch shape distribution isn't reflected in training samples.
Maria L.: ```
[2026-03-15 02:12:31] PICK: model=redwood-13B seq=512 batch=2 arch=ampere selected=int8_gemm_v2 score=1.12 alt=fused_gemm score=1.05 flags=KPICK_VOTE,SEQ_BUCKET=512
[2026-03-15 02:12:31] PERF: p50_tok=22ms p95_tok=45ms kv_hit=0.98
```
Aj Patel: what env flags were set? I usually run with REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KPICK_DEBUG=1 KPICK_SEQ_BUCKETS="0-64,65-256,257-1024" KPICK_WEIGHT_SCALE=1.0
Ella K: i toggled KPICK_WEIGHT_SCALE=0.8 in a canary and it fell back to fused_gemm, p95 dropped ~7ms. suggest seqlen-aware penalty for int8 path when batch <4.
Maria L.: let's dump scoreboard for a problematic run: `rdwctl runtime debug dump-scoreboard --model redwood-13B --seq 512 --out /tmp/scoreboard.json`
infra-bot: Deploy started: rdw-canary-20260315 (canary id: c-20260315-09)
Sanjay R: also saw KV cache warming spike — cache miss amplification when batch shapes vary. we should instrument kv hit by prefix length (kv_prefix_hit_ratio).
Aj Patel: proposed telemetry fields: `kpick_chosen`, `kpick_confidence`, `kpick_reasons`, `seq_bucket`, `batch_size`, `kv_prefix_hit`, `token_latency_p50`, `token_latency_p95`, `perf_sample_id`.
Maria L.: agree. also add debug flag `KPICK_LOG_DECISIONS=1` to include textual reasons (e.g., "memory_pressure", "gemm_family_penalty").
Ella K: PR #4821 adds reason logging and a small seq-penalty. can we run loadgen on staging with mix: 128@70%, 512@20%, 1024@10%?
Aj Patel: ack — i'll run nightly loadgen (profile+trace) and upload a gist.
Sanjay R: note: avoid logging exact kernel names in prod to reduce churn; mask to family like `int8_gemm_v2 -> int8_gemm`.
Maria L.: noted. thanks all :thumbsup:
